overloads.semanticRole: The VP SET BINDING PATH command binds an attribute from a sheet's data context to rangeObj .

constraints: If rangeObj is a range with several cells, the attribute is bound only to the first cell of the range; if rangeObj contains several ranges of cells, it is bound to the first cell of each range.
If dataContextAttribute is an empty string, the command removes the current binding instead of setting one.
Attributes of type collection are not supported; passing the name of a collection attribute makes the command do nothing.
A data context must first be set on the sheet with VP SET DATA CONTEXT for the binding to have any effect.
